feeds.title: Abandoned Central Blog
feeds.description: Abandoned Central Blog features our most recent exploring trips.

feeds.title: Abandoned Southeast
feeds.description: My name is Leland Kent and I have had an interest in abandoned places ever since I was a kid. My goal is to showcase the obscure, sometimes historic, forgotten places I have visited across the Southeast.

feeds.title: RiddimRyder Blog
feeds.description: Hi there, My name is Jamie & I am an Ontario-based adventurer. Follow me along on my amazing adventures as I explore abandoned & forgotten places. I am constantly doing research & driving in search of new abandoned locations to explore & document.

feeds.title: Obsidian Urbex Photography Blog
feeds.description: I am Janine Pendleton, also known as Obsidian Urbex Photography. Catch up with site news, travel diaries, upcoming plans, gear reviews, and other featured items. Read stories of my journeys and adventures around the world, in search of lost treasures.

feeds.title: Abandoned Cubicle
feeds.description: Welcome to abandoned cubicle, where I write about the race to early retirement, personal finance, cubicle job survival, its merits, and its pitfalls. Follow along and find yourself some inspiration, save a few bucks, and focus on what's truly important in life.

feeds.title: Abandoned Florida
feeds.description: Abandoned Florida is dedicated to documenting and reporting news on historically endangered, abandoned, and neglected sites throughout the state of Florida. David Bulit is a photographer, author, and historian from Miami, Florida. He has published a number of books on abandoned and forgotten locales throughout the United States and continues to advocate for preserving these historic landmarks.

feeds.title: Abandoned Ni
feeds.description: Abandoned Ni travels the length and breadth of the Island of Ireland visiting and documenting our abandoned buildings, highlighting their social importance, and bringing the history and stories of the lives from the past back to life through the medium of photography.

feeds.title: Abandoned NC Blog
feeds.description: Abandoned NC started out in 2003 as a way to display photos of abandoned buildings from 'urban exploring' around North Carolina. Today you'll also find folklore, history articles, collected ephemera, and anything else from the Old North State that piques my interest.

feeds.title: Architectural Afterlife
feeds.description: Architectural Afterlife is a blog that was started in 2012 by Cleveland photographer Johnny Joo, sharing the beauty of dusty old Midwest farmhouses and gritty industrial remains of the rust belt. Eventually, the blog content started covering much more than just the Midwest.

feeds.title: The Abandoned Places
feeds.description: Do broken shutters, peeling paint and overgrown yards of abandoned buildings beckon you? For many of us, abandoned houses have a mysterious and haunting beauty. They may have weathered clapboard and boarded windows, but their souls still cry out for redemption.

feeds.title: Abandoned Wonders
feeds.description: Here at Abandoned Wonders, we enjoy exploring, researching, and documenting abandoned locations all over New England. May it be railroad stations, homes, cars/trucks, movie theaters, sanatoriums, and more! We love to share our adventures and what we learned along the way about each individual location.

feeds.title: Abandoned House Studios Blog
feeds.description: Abandoned House Studios is a team of passionate game designers crafting experiences in Pensacola, FL.

feeds.title: Abandoned Berlin
feeds.description: Abandoned Berlin is an attempt to document the past, uncover the hidden history and preserve the memory of neglected glories - as they are now. I've put together what I hope are useful guides, to help people reach these places, share some of the stories and detail some of the difficulties/hazards involved.
